issues_detected.description: The record is an undeclared mapping with four release resources, so the instrument scores each release as a member dataset. The rich discovery, use-guidance, motivation, funding and attribution metadata is written only at collection level and is not inherited by the releases.
issues_detected.recommendation: Declare the parent as a Dataset (conforms_to_class) if it is the dataset to score, or attach the shared metadata to each release resource.

issues_detected.description: File formats and media types are recorded in top-level file_collections and distribution_formats, outside the release resources; no release states its formats, encoding or standard conformance.
issues_detected.recommendation: Nest each release's file collection and formats (ZIP, JSON, HTML, RO-Crate) inside the release resource and state conformance there.

issues_detected.description: Ethics review, human-subjects status, de-identification, governance contact and regulatory statements are absent from every release resource.
issues_detected.recommendation: Record each release's Data Governance & Ethics fields on the release itself.

issues_detected.description: No release reports instance counts, variables, tabular flags or split/subpopulation flags.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add per-release counts (proteins, images, perturbed genes) and variable-level metadata.

issues_detected.description: Collection mechanisms, acquisition methods, processing steps and processing software are not documented on any release; derivation is stated only for the June 2025 release.
issues_detected.recommendation: Attach collection/acquisition methods, processing steps with named software, and derivation to each release.

issues_detected.description: Version-access guidance, errata/change descriptions and update schedule are absent on the releases; only the June 2025 release describes its changes.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add change descriptions and version-access guidance to each release.

issues_detected.description: Known limitations, biases, anomalies and missing-data documentation are absent from the releases (one embargo note on the October 2025 release).
issues_detected.recommendation: Record release-specific limitations, embargoes and quality issues on each release.

issues_detected.description: The June 2026 release carries version '2.0' while the earlier June and October 2025 releases carry '2.1'; the March 2025 release shows version 1.4 against a citation ending V1 (disclosed in source_caveats). Versions are per-DOI Dataverse versions, so they do not order the releases.
issues_detected.recommendation: State that version numbers are per-release Dataverse versions, not a series order.

issues_detected.description: The project's release page dates the June 2026 release 'June 17, 2025' while Dataverse gives 2026-06-17; the record discloses the conflict and uses the Dataverse date, which is consistent with the distribution_dates list.
Creator name 'Ballllosero Navarro F' contains an implausible run of four l characters, probably transcribed from the source author list.
issues_detected.recommendation: Verify the spelling against the source author list.

semantic_insights: Scope: the input has no class wrapper or conforms_to_class and has four nonempty resources, so the instrument's collection interpretation applies; each item score is the minimum over the four Dataverse releases, judged on each release's own fields.

The collection-level record is far richer than its releases (keywords, use guidance, ethics review contacts, de-identification, subpopulations with RRIDs, collection mechanisms, MuSIC pipeline, funders with NIH award numbers, 47 creators, limitations, biases, missing-data patterns, quarterly update schedule); none of it is inherited by the releases, which explains the low score.

Release resources carry title, DOI, version, issue date, landing page, licence and a modality/cell-line description; the June 2025 release adds a change description and the June 2026 release a full citation.
